title: Value Distribution and Picard-type Theorems for Total Differential Polynomials in $\mathbb{C}^n$
summary: This paper investigates the value distribution and growth properties of linear total differential polynomials $\mathcal{L}_k[D]f$ for meromorphic functions in several complex variables $\mathbb{C}^n$. By extending the classical Milloux inequality to the framework of total derivatives, we derive a series of fundamental growth estimates for the Nevanlinna characteristic function $T(r, \mathcal{L}_k[D]f)$.
